name.zh-Hans: 智谱 GLM Flash 免费模型

description.en: GLM-4-Flash is announced as permanently free with basically no call-volume limit (newer GLM-4.7-Flash is also free); sign-up also grants learning credits for paid GLM models (community reports ~20M tokens).
description.zh-Hans: GLM-4-Flash 宣布长期免费、基本不限调用量（后续推出的 GLM-4.7-Flash 同样免费）；注册另有可用于付费 GLM 模型的学习额度（社区反馈约 2,000 万 tokens）。

detail.en: Zhipu AI (智谱) is a leading Chinese LLM provider whose MaaS platform continuously offers free Flash-tier models: GLM-4-Flash (text) is announced as permanently free without call-volume restrictions, the newer GLM-4.7-Flash is also free, and GLM-4V-Flash offers free image understanding. New accounts receive learning credits usable on paid GLM models (community reports about 20M tokens; check the official console). Free-tier concurrency limits exist but are generous; current values are in the official rate-limit document. Sign up with a Chinese phone number; no credit card needed.
detail.zh-Hans: 智谱 AI 是国内头部大模型厂商，其 MaaS 平台长期提供免费 Flash 档模型：GLM-4-Flash（文本）已宣布永久免费、基本不限调用量，后续推出的 GLM-4.7-Flash 同样免费，GLM-4V-Flash 提供免费的图像理解能力。新账号注册会赠送学习额度，可用于付费 GLM 模型（社区反馈约 2,000 万 tokens，以官方控制台为准）。免费模型存在并发限制但较为宽裕，当前数值见官方速率限制文档。使用手机号即可注册；无需信用卡。

freeLimit.en: GLM-4-Flash permanent free without call-volume limit (GLM-4.7-Flash also free); paid GLM models come with sign-up learning credits (commonly reported ~20M tokens). Check the official console and rate-limit doc.
freeLimit.zh-Hans: GLM-4-Flash 永久免费、基本不限调用量（GLM-4.7-Flash 同样免费）；付费 GLM 模型注册赠学习额度（社区反馈约 2,000 万 tokens）。以官方控制台与速率限制文档为准。

registrationRestriction.en: Sign up with a phone number (mainland China numbers supported); no credit card required. Some paid services may require real-name verification.
registrationRestriction.zh-Hans: 手机号注册（支持中国大陆号码）即可，无需信用卡；部分付费服务可能需要实名认证。

frequency.en: Permanent free, no call-volume limit (generous concurrency; see official rate-limit doc)
frequency.zh-Hans: 长期免费、不限调用量（并发较宽裕，以官方速率限制文档为准）

frequency.en: Free tier with rate limits; see official doc
frequency.zh-Hans: 免费档有限速，以官方文档为准

model.en: Paid GLM models (GLM-4 Plus, GLM-5 series etc.)
model.zh-Hans: 付费 GLM 模型（GLM-4 Plus、GLM-5 系列等）

quota.zh-Hans: 注册赠学习额度（社区反馈约 2,000 万 tokens）

frequency.en: One-time credits per account; validity per official console
frequency.zh-Hans: 每个账号一次，以官方控制台为准
